svg.title: SCKE Transformative Architecture
svg.desc: SCKE Transformative Architecture — Arch. adaptation from On-Prem to AWS Cloud Services Hosting. CAPA provisions EKS; Services plane includes Argo CD, Velero; Karpenter on Workload; OTel + LGTM, secrets, identity, data, observability.
svg.text: Arch. adaptation from On-Prem to AWS Cloud Services Hosting
Turtles / CAPI / CAPA · order: Services then Workload
CAPA controller + EKS CP + node IAM
Services use IRSA / Pod Identity later
SERVICES PLANE · on EKS · platform capabilities (CI/CD is part of this plane)
CI/CD · CONTINUOUS DELIVERY (GitOps CD) · team: CI/CD
Workload cluster only · reports to Principal · independent reconcile
Workload cluster only · just-in-time EC2 for pending pods · consolidates underutilized nodes
Cluster / namespace backup & restore · also on Workload plane · often backs up to S3
WORKLOAD PLANE · Amazon EKS (CAPA substrate + runtime)
Stack order: Services plane → Workload plane · Karpenter · Knative · Velero · OpenBao ← ESO · Argo GitOps
Side rails: On Prem (AD/LDAP · SMTP · MS Teams) · AWS (EFS · EBS · S3) — not planes
Three clusters: management/ · services · workload · ARCHITECTURE.md §7
